chunks: O man, you have to strive and go on striving towards your Lord, then will you meet Him.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the human journey towards God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'kadhan' (striving) is often interpreted as a continuous, sometimes arduous, effort that defines the human condition in this transient world. This verse serves as a profound reminder of accountability, reinforcing the concept of *Ma'ad* (return) where every individual's deeds, whether good or ill, will be directly presented before Allah. It underscores the inevitability of the Hereafter, urging believers to align their worldly struggles with spiritual preparation for that ultimate encounter.
